title: A new perspective reveals the whole

captions.physics: Showing a considered line of thought

meaning: A considered explanation and willingness to change perspective can help a conversation feel whole without making the new understanding a final truth.
text: Your Vishuddha offers a way to connect separate remarks through a considered explanation. The Hermit in the physical position helps you show a line of thought you can now share. The Hanged Man in energy encourages reconsidering a familiar perspective: perhaps the conversation works differently from how it first appeared. The World in emotions brings a sense of coherence as the beginning and conclusion stop seeming contradictory. New understanding can offer relief without declaring the earlier words wrong.

For example, you recall a disagreement that began with “Why did you not tell me anything?” and ended in a discussion of the day’s news. After reflection, you offer another perspective: perhaps the question concerned wanting to participate in the telling rather than the amount of information exchanged. **Another view helps you hear the whole conversation**. You check the thought through each other’s answers. If it fits, brief remarks form an understandable account, and you may feel the conversation has finally reached its actual subject.

Difficulty arises if the pleasing coherence of the new version makes it untouchable. A clarification then seems to threaten the whole picture, while a considered explanation begins defending itself. Constructive willingness to change perspective helps keep that picture open to additions. A conversation can become more understandable without being finally solved; a feeling of completion does not require rejecting a detail that appears later.
